remarks: One block from New Canaan's fine restaurants, shops and train. Spacious 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath townhouse in professionally maintained complex of 8 units. Unit is currently being refurbished. Hardwood floors throughout the EIK, dining room and Living room. LR has a wood burning fireplace, and slider to flagstone patio. Primary bedroom is on the first floor with its own bath. Second floor has two bedrooms that share a hall bath and a rec/den room. Entire unit is being repainted, new stove, all tiling regrouted. New Vanity in guest bath with quartz counter. New Granite counter being installed in powder room. Tenant pays rent, utilities and $500 sewer. Credit of 720+, credit check, first month's rent and two month's security deposit. Professional landlord maintains the exterior, landscaping, snow removal. No pets per HOA. Available 8/15. No Co-Signers or Guarantors allowed. 500k Limited liability ins. required. Addendum to lease required.
